process.label: How we work
process.subtitle: No forms landing in a shared inbox, no generic discovery calls. This is the actual path a request takes.

steps.triage_desc: An engineer reviews your request, validates the feasibility of the stack you propose, and confirms team availability.
steps.call_desc: A technical session to understand the real scope, the constraints you already have, and the criteria you will measure success by.
steps.packet_desc: You receive the proposed team composition, timeline estimates, and the identified risk matrix, in writing.

faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.ip_q: Who owns the code and the intellectual property?
faq.ip_a: 100% of the intellectual property and the code transfers to your company. CorosDev retains no rights over what we build for you.
faq.response_q: How quickly do you answer a request?
faq.response_a: We reply to every request within 24 business hours. Your message is read by an engineer, not a sales intermediary, so the first reply already comes with concrete technical questions.
faq.engagement_q: What engagement models do you offer?
faq.engagement_a: We work through dedicated engineering pods, fixed-scope product sprints, and reinforcement of existing teams. The model is defined in the deep-dive call, based on the scope and pace you need.
faq.nearshore_q: How does the nearshore model work?
faq.nearshore_a: Our engineering centers in Honduras operate in the same time zone as the US central region, with full working-day overlap. We add a presence in Prague for European coverage.

seo.title: Services - CorosDev
seo.description: Explore the elite technology services and strategic frameworks of CorosDev - AI automation, custom software, digital growth, and scalable systems.

hero.sub: We don't just deliver services. We engineer competitive advantages. Each engagement is powered by a proprietary framework that connects technology, growth, and scale.

methodology.label: How We Operate
methodology.sub: Our methodology is what separates us from a typical software agency. We operate as a strategic partner, not a vendor.
methodology.step1_desc: We begin with a deep technical and business audit. We identify bottlenecks, opportunities, and your competitive moat before writing a single line of code.
methodology.step2_desc: We design scalable systems with future growth in mind. Architecture decisions are driven by data, not trends — ensuring your tech stack remains an asset, not a liability.
methodology.step3_desc: Agile sprints. Dedicated teams. Transparent communication. We ship fast without sacrificing quality, giving you a competitive edge in days, not months.
methodology.step4_desc: Post-launch is where we differentiate. Continuous optimization, performance monitoring, and strategic growth ensure your platform evolves ahead of the market.

pillars.label: How We Help
pillars.sub: Whether you need to build, hire, or lead — here's exactly what working with CorosDev looks like.
pillars.customSoftware_pain: Technical debt slows every release, your internal team doesn't have the bandwidth to ship real AI, and MVPs were never built to survive their own growth.
pillars.customSoftware_solution: End-to-end development under our Discover → Scale framework: cloud-native architecture from day one, AI workflow automation, and integrations built around your existing stack — not a rewrite of it.
pillars.customSoftware_why1: Auditable code and security standards from the first commit, not bolted on before launch.
pillars.customSoftware_why2: AI-accelerated prototyping — the same internal tooling we use to run CorosDev, applied to your product.
pillars.customSoftware_why3: 30-day risk-free trial, plus a 14-day review-and-acceptance window on every milestone.
pillars.scalingTalent_pain: Hiring senior engineers takes two to four months, half the candidates don't actually know the stack on their resume, and a bad fit costs you the whole quarter.
pillars.scalingTalent_solution: Pre-vetted senior engineers — technically and culturally screened before you ever see a name — aligned to your time zone and folded into your workflow, not the other way around.
pillars.scalingTalent_why1: 3 to 5 candidate profiles within 24-72 business hours of intake.
pillars.scalingTalent_why2: One point of contact, always — no account managers who don't know your project.
pillars.scalingTalent_why3: We work your hours: real-time overlap with US/EU time zones.
pillars.scalingTalent_kpi3: Zero-fee conversion to full-time after 6 months
pillars.techPartnership_pain: Founders and executives are making architecture calls under deadline pressure instead of strategy, and nobody owns the long-term technical roadmap.
pillars.techPartnership_solution: Technical leadership as a service: systems design, cloud infrastructure roadmap, and a dedicated squad covering AI, development, and growth — under a single technical owner.
pillars.techPartnership_why1: A long-term partner, not a project that ends at handover.
pillars.techPartnership_why2: You report to us directly — no layers, no hand-offs between account teams.
pillars.techPartnership_why3: We run our own operations on the same AI tooling we design into yours.

faq.label: Before You Book the Call
faq.q1_q: How do you protect our IP and confidential data?
faq.q1_a: 100% of code, design, and work product belongs to you from day one. Every team member signs a strict NDA before touching your project.
faq.q2_q: What if the engagement isn't the right fit?
faq.q2_a: Every engagement opens with a 30-day risk-free trial. If we don't meet expectations, you don't pay — and for staff augmentation, we replace the engineer at no extra cost within 10 business days.
faq.q3_q: What does onboarding actually look like?
faq.q3_a: We start with a Discovery Call, followed by a technical and business audit before a single line of code or a single candidate is presented. You get a scoped plan within 48 hours.
faq.q4_q: How do you measure success on a long-term engagement?
faq.q4_a: Every milestone has a structured 14-day review-and-acceptance window, and CTO Advisory engagements run on a quarterly roadmap with measurable architecture and delivery KPIs.
faq.q5_q: Do you actually work across time zones?
faq.q5_a: Yes — our team aligns to your working hours for real-time communication, not asynchronous hand-offs days later.

seo.title: Ecosystem - CorosDev
seo.description: Explore the CorosDev ecosystem. We build our own high-tech internal ventures alongside our client services: Accesorios TRD, Snapay, and Vorzana.

hero.label: Internal Ventures
hero.sub: Beyond client work, we build our own products. These are the ventures born inside CorosDev, each solving a real problem at scale.

ventures.trd_desc: Online store for automotive accessories with a curated catalog, aimed at the LATAM and North American market.
ventures.trd_detail: Accesorios TRD came out of a real gap in the LATAM market: automotive parts with no reliable online destination. We built the entire platform — storefront, logistics integrations, and inventory management — in house.
ventures.snapay_desc: Payment collection infrastructure for merchants: instant settlement, multi-currency support, and encrypted rails under the PCI-DSS standard.
ventures.snapay_detail: Snapay addresses the fragmentation of payments across LATAM, where a large share of SMEs remains out of reach of traditional banking. Its API-first architecture is designed so a merchant can start accepting payments without a bespoke integration.
ventures.vorzana_desc: Business intelligence platform: custom dashboards, analytics over operational data, and automated reporting.
ventures.vorzana_detail: Vorzana grew out of an operational pain we kept seeing in our own clients: plenty of data accumulated, little actionable reading of it. We built an analytics layer that answers in the language of the business.

cta.p: We are actively building strategic relationships with capital partners, sector experts, and distributors to scale these internal ventures globally.

grid.eiw_desc: Custom web development, mobile apps, and enterprise ERP/CRM software — delivering data-driven solutions across real estate, healthcare, finance, and e-commerce.
grid.sbc_desc: A private acquisition firm investing in lower middle-market businesses across the U.S. and Europe, acting as permanent, long-term owners.
grid.audela_desc: A French software company delivering Business Intelligence, ERP, and LegalTech solutions through its unified Control Tower platform.
grid.nolim_desc: A software development studio building custom software, AI systems, AR/VR experiences, SaaS platforms, and games — from air traffic systems to judicial education platforms.
grid.intellify_desc: An AI and digital product engineering company building intelligent automation, AI agents, and modernized platforms for enterprises across regulated industries.
